HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

2. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   B. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   D. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   C. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   D. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   B. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

15. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Linguistic groups in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Establishment of colonial rule and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
